headlines.title: UK growth upgraded but energy prices and rates to bite in 2027
headlines.description: The IMF report comes as final preparations are being made to the first Budget under Prime Minister Andy Burham.

headlines.title: Bumble shares soar after report dating firm in $1bn takeover talks
headlines.description: The jump pushed Bumble's stock market valuation to more than $580m but that is still far below their peak of more than $14bn.

headlines.title: Healey faces £35bn Budget challenge to meet spending pledges, says think tank
headlines.description: The Institute for Fiscal Studies says the government will need a "top-up" of billions of pounds if it wants to meet its spending plans.

headlines.title: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
headlines.description: Hundreds of stores were targeted by the overnight hack, which spoiled fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.

headlines.title: AI is less regulated than milk, says Microsoft president
headlines.description: Brad Smith calls for global rules on AI, and says the UK is in the "best position" to lead the charge.
